defaults.string_a: Animate the subject and scene shown in <Picture 1> using the performance and camera trajectory in <Video 1>. Use the current photo as the appearance reference throughout: the same face and individual facial features, hair style, colour and length, skin tone, natural shadows, body proportions and volume, exact outfit, accessories and natural skin and fabric texture. Do not borrow the video performer identity, hair, body shape, clothes, wrist accessories or other appearance details. Keep the photo scene and illumination character; do not import unrelated video objects, add jewellery, alter garments, smooth textures or apply artificial bokeh. Transfer the video body and hand motion, head movement, gaze and performance timing. Follow the source camera, including genuine shake, roll and framing changes; At every corresponding video moment, reproduce the source facial expression and its intensity: eyebrow raises and furrows, eyelid opening and blinks, eye direction, cheek movement, smiles, mouth corners, lip shape, mouth opening and speech articulation, with the same onset and release timing. The photo defines facial identity and texture, not a frozen expression. Let those same facial features move with the video performance; do not keep the photo smile or neutral mouth when the video expression changes. keep a stationary source camera stationary. Do not stabilize, add drift or replace the moving pose with the photo pose. Keep the same character and materials from the first frame to the last. Visible photo appearance:

defaults.prompt: Describe only the attached photo in concise English: visible facial details, hair colour, style and length, skin colour, visible garments and their exact colours, neckline, sleeves, material and pattern, visible accessories and hand coverings, and visible scene and illumination. Describe only what can actually be seen. Do not invent watches, jewellery, clothing, hidden body parts, identity, age or ethnicity. Do not estimate, reshape or beautify the body. Do not describe a different photo or a video. Return only the visible appearance description, without headings, instructions or reasoning.
